title: Tesla Stock News (Oct 14, 2026): TSLA Falls 0.7% to $375.23
summary: Tesla (TSLA) closed at $375.23 on Oct 13, 2026, down 0.74%, as an analyst note on $25 billion-plus spending led the day's coverage.
body_markdown:
Tesla now trades 24.78% below its 52-week high of $498.83 and 26.18% above its 52-week low of $297.38, with a market value of $1.49 trillion.


## Why Tesla Stock Fell


No fetched source named a company-specific cause for Tuesday's drop, which was small and came on thin volume in a soft Nasdaq session. The most prominent Tesla story of the day was about spending.


As reported by[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-target-lowered-analysts-worried-203300332.html) , BNP Paribas revised its view on the stock this week over concerns about cash burn, after Tesla said early in 2026 that capital expenditure would rise above $25 billion, including AI investment and converting former Model S and Model X lines to build its Optimus humanoid robot. According to the same report, CFO Vaibhav Taneja said Tesla "will face negative free cash flow impacts for the remainder of the year."


The news flow was not all negative. Per[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/tesla-robotaxi-fleet-austin-soars-213024117.html) , Tesla's official Robotaxi account said over the weekend that its fleet in Austin had reached "300+ Cybercabs," which Tesla described as "an 8x increase in 30 days."


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to Tesla's[third-quarter production and deliveries release](https://www.financialcontent.com/article/bizwire-2026-10-2-tesla-third-quarter-2026-production-deliveries-and-deployments) , the company delivered 486,532 vehicles and deployed 13.7 GWh of energy storage in Q3 2026.
- Tesla says its Austin Cybercab fleet grew to more than 300 vehicles in 30 days, according to Benzinga.


### Risks


- Capital spending above $25 billion and negative free cash flow for the rest of the year, as the CFO acknowledged, according to TheStreet.
- BNP Paribas analysts noted that Tesla's AI division has produced 169 Cybercabs and no Optimus robots for sale so far, per TheStreet.


Tesla's release says it will report third-quarter results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026.
